lessons.reason: Concrete response identities survive checker, infrastructure and parser repairs into an actual normalized categorical update. Counterexamples change actual submitted text, trusted measurements, active vectors, normalization weights or product gates. Exact completed-clause frames verify the short strict-parser zero result and separate final statistics, gradient, exponentials and probability reveals. Secondary architecture/report tables, long settled holds, compact scalar rows and brief intermediate payoff dwell retain earned deductions. No material blocker was found.
